tasks.task_description: Check libs.versions.toml for Ktor client runtime support
Verify sharedModel/build.gradle.kts has Ktor client dependencies
Verify manual SSE parsing with ByteReadChannel reader
Confirm HTTP POST RPC delivery mechanism
Verify connection drop detection via readUTF8Line() and isConnected()

description: Validate claims about REST client API system implementation and connection drop detection
context: Verified libs.versions.toml has ktor-client-core, ktor-client-cio, and ktor-client-js entries. sharedModel/build.gradle.kts includes these Ktor client dependencies in commonMain (core), jvmMain (cio), and jsMain (js) source sets.

Found and verified RpcMessageHandler centralizes request/response/stream dispatch between RpcRegistry, RpcInvoker, and pluggable transport. RestRpcClient has configurable endpoints/playerId via RestRpcClientConfig, manual SSE parsing with ByteReadChannel.readUTF8Line(), HTTP POST RPC delivery, RpcInvoker exposure, and lifecycle helpers (connect, disconnect, close). Connection drop detection works via readUTF8Line() returning null and isConnected() based on coroutine job status.
Verified ./gradlew :sharedModel:build works successfully. No stubs, TODOs, or incomplete implementations found in RpcMessageHandler.kt or RestRpcClient.kt - both are fully implemented.
